gloss: right next to one's ear; close to the ear

definitions.gloss: right next to one's ear; close to the ear
definitions.explanation: The area immediately beside someone's ear. Typically used in expressions about whispering, shouting close by, or sounds heard from very near.

examples.japanese: {耳元|みみもと}でささやいた。
examples.english: She whispered right next to my ear.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{耳元|みみもと}で「{頑張|がんば}って」と{言|い}った。
examples.english: My mother said "do your best" close to my ear.

examples.japanese: {蚊|か}が{耳元|みみもと}でブンブンと{飛|と}び{回|まわ}って{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: A mosquito was buzzing right next to my ear, so I couldn't sleep.

notes:
Compound of {耳|みみ} (ear) + {元|もと} (vicinity, base). The {元|もと} element indicates the spot immediately adjacent to something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳元|みみもと}でささやく: to whisper in someone's ear
- {耳元|みみもと}で{叫|さけ}ぶ: to shout right next to someone's ear
- {耳元|みみもと}で{囁|ささや}く: to murmur close to the ear
- {耳元|みみもと}に{口|くち}を{寄|よ}せる: to bring one's mouth close to the ear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {耳|みみ}のそば: by the ear — more neutral, less idiomatic
- {耳|みみ}たぶ: earlobe — the body part, not the space around it
